translationRepairs: Chinese 〈（延壽）〉 is a parenthetical name gloss for Yanshou; the trailing )]〉 in the idiomatic field are leftover commentary-markup artifacts, not source text.
The literal likewise retains stray >〉 after (Yanshou); the Chinese annotation supports only the name gloss itself.
〈（德樞紹勛紹芳資讓）〉 lists Deshu, Shaoxun, Shaofang, and Zirang; the trailing )]〉 are markup artifacts and should be stripped.
The literal field's trailing >〉 are the same corrupted markup leftovers; the Chinese supports only the four names in parentheses.
匡嗣 romanizes as Kuangsi (Kuāngsì), not Kuangsai; stripping the leftover )]〉 also matches the Chinese annotation 〈（匡嗣德源德凝）〉.
Literal must likewise correct Kuangsai to Kuangsi for 匡嗣 and remove the corrupted >〉 markup characters.
Every affair that touched both Khitan and Han he entrusted to Mojie to settle; each decision matched the emperor's wishes.
Every affair that touched both Khitan and Han he entrusted to Moji to settle; each decision matched the emperor's wishes.
屬默記折衷之 refers to Kang Moji (康默記); Mojie is an inconsistent misspelling of the same 默記 already rendered Moji in the biography opening.
Yelu Dila, whose courtesy name was Heluyin, was a son of the Jianzhi Khan of the Yaolian clan.
Yelu Dila, whose courtesy name was Heluyin, was a son of the Xianzhi Khan of the Yaolian clan.
鮮質可汗 is Xianzhi Khan (Xiānzhì), not Jianzhi; 鮮 is xiān, so the proposed replacement restores the correct reading.
Before he came of age he was made Left General of the Feathered Forest Guard, then promoted to specially advanced Grand Guardian.
Before he came of age he was made Left General of the Feathered Forest Guard, then promoted to specially advanced Grand Commandant.
遷特進太尉 is promotion to specially advanced Grand Commandant (太尉); Grand Guardian is 太保 and is not in the Chinese.
